$comment: Private signing keys never live in the repository. Production keys are KSIGN_<id> secrets that the two reusable build workflows (reusable-build.yml, reusable-cache-kernel.yml) write to certs/production/<id>.key with `just write-signing-keys` and delete with `just remove-signing-keys`; certs/production/*.key is gitignored. The only committed private keys are the public test keys in certs/test/*.key. certs/private_key.priv is a leftover 0-byte placeholder that nothing reads (FORK-PATCHES.md T11). See docs/security/SECURITY-AI.md.
